author: haiku
label: climb-05-01
changes: Changed: The callback checks the cookie first, then removes the attempt with one atomic GETDEL, replacing the separate delete-then-ask step. A duplicate callback is refused without a race, and a cookie mismatch uses up nothing.
Changed: A linked Google login refuses while locked_until is in the future. This adopts open decision 1, so a lock cannot be bypassed through Google.
Changed: Settings linking refuses an unverified Google email. This adopts open decision 2 for consistency with login.
Changed: A successful password confirmation sets email_verified_at with COALESCE. users.email is not changed. This adopts open decision 3.
Changed: The wrong-password branch now shows that failed_logins is saved +1. The flowchart was missing that write.
Changed: The source of return_to is stated at start. This makes open decision 4 explicit in the text.
Changed: PKCE code_challenge is named at the start and consent steps. It was only implied before.
Changed: The file now runs summary, terms, diagram, steps, failures, state, build section, open questions. Schema SQL moved to a build section. Short terms were added for every new name.
Changed: Failure table rows added for Redis down at confirm, and for unique-violation races. Failure text that repeated the flowchart was merged into one table.
Changed: The Google-created user's recovery path is stated: Forgot password sets a password, and it is the route that unlink points to.
Changed: Open questions reduced to two. Redis GETDEL version and the linked-login email_verified check are now listed as holes.
Cut the long Summary and its repeated statements. The first section now says how sign-in works today, then how the Google flow adds to it, then why the password step exists.
Rewrote every term as one plain line. Added definitions for the sid cookie and the existing lockout fields, which the steps use.
Rewrote the steps so each one says what starts it, what it does, which data it keeps and what happens if it fails. Steps no longer depend on codes or on other documents.
Added the reason for the cookie check before GETDEL: a bad cookie does not use up the attempt. This was implied before and is now stated.
Added the reason for the password step, taken from the answer to the question about the threat: a verified Google email proves control of the Google account, not of our account.
Merged the two confirm-step lock branches into one rule. Merged the settings refusals (unverified, linked to another user, already linked) into one ordered list.
Merged the duplicate failure rows for the login and settings unique violations into one row, and removed the duplicate settings rows from the failure table.

Shortened the Mermaid node labels and removed the red failure styling. The diagram covers both entry points, every callback outcome and the password loop. Unlink moved out of the diagram into step 11, which is text.
Step 10 (Sign in) now clears only gpending, not oidc_state. The callback already clears oidc_state, so the earlier wording repeated that action.
Moved the schema and the POST /login NULL-hash rule into a separate How to build it section, apart from How it runs.
Added to the open questions the hole from the answer about the code exchange: the Google-side details were not re-checked against current Google documentation.
No behaviour was changed. The junior's rounds produced no Changed lines, and every requirement in the brief is still in the file.
